title: Sensing Ventricular Arrhythmias by His Bundle Leads
brief_summary: The purpose of this trial is to determine if implantable cardiac device leads implanted in the His bundle are capable of detecting ventricular arrhythmias.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals undergoing routine defibrillation threshold testing of a right ventricular implantable cardioverter defibrillator lead who also have previously placed His bundle lead or who are undergoing placement of a His bundle lead.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals with contraindications to defibrillation threshold testing
study_population: Individuals undergoing routine defibrillation threshold testing of a right ventricular implantable cardioverter defibrillator lead who also have previously placed His bundle lead or who are undergoing placement of a His bundle lead.
